title: Bhaav And Planets
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 7 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. The 12 houses as a body, what each one holds, remedies by house, and the question and answer round.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 7, Bhaav And Planets by Brajesh Gautam: the 12 houses, body map, relationships, ancestors, donations and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Conscious, subconscious and unconscious. Train the top layer by repetition and you change yourself, not your fate.
You rise to a written level.
Luck lifts you about as far as you were set to go. Awareness decides how well you use it.
Signs and planets move through them, but the first house is always you and the seventh always the partner.
The speaker maps body parts to houses. These are his readings and a doctor comes first.
Guru and partner, grace and desire. The Sanjeevani story is his picture of it.
If the fifth house is disturbed, settle the ancestors first, with love for children and rites.
Cash can backfire if the sign is Mercury. Service and items fit more charts.
